plan: 16-01 Metrics v2 and round trips (BT-08, BT-09; criterion 2)
status: Implemented by subagent for orchestrator gate run. Tests, lint, typecheck and format were not run by the subagent; the orchestrator runs the gates once after merge.
metrics_implemented: total_return (Decimal ratio; None when opening equity <= 0)
max_drawdown (Decimal fraction of running peak; None when no positive peak)
sharpe_ratio (annualized; None when annualization_valid is false, fewer than 2 returns, or zero sample standard deviation)
sortino_ratio (annualized; None when annualization_valid is false, fewer than 2 returns, or no losing step)
hit_rate (Decimal; None when no closed round trip)
profit_factor (Decimal; None when no losing closed round trip)
expectancy_lamports (Decimal lamports mean per closed round trip; None when no closed round trip)
annualization_valid (bool; true when elapsed window >= 7 days; never None)

deviations.reason: The v1 core Fill model carries no mint and no ticket reference. Round trips need both, so the book from round_trips() is the input.

deviations.plan_item: round_trips(fills) consumes Fill rows from backtest/equity.py
deviations.implemented_as: round_trips(rows, ticket_refs) consumes ledger rows in the read() shape that equity.net_lamports folds. It reads no ledger itself.
deviations.reason: Same reason as above. The rows carry mint, ticket and cash deltas. Ticket-to-strategy references are passed in, not read from the store.

deviations.plan_item: Realized P&L excludes the ATA deposit refunded at close
deviations.implemented_as: Realized P&L of a closed round trip is the sum of its fills' cash_delta_lamports. The deposit is debited in the opening buy (inside its network cost) and credited in the closing sell, so the two cancel. This matches the paper adapter identity proceeds + refund - cost_basis.
deviations.reason: No deposit sidecar read is needed. A test asserts 290, not 330, for the case where the refund would otherwise count as profit.

deviations.plan_item: Breakdown keys by strategy with unattributed for fills with no ref
deviations.implemented_as: Key is 'unattributed' per plan. breakdown() takes the caller-supplied desk total and raises ValueError when keys do not sum to it. Open positions are excluded because they carry no realized P&L.
deviations.reason: strategies/attribution.py uses 'desk' and requires a LedgerStore, so it is not reused here.

deviations.plan_item: Open position contributes only its mark
deviations.implemented_as: OpenTrip.mark_lamports uses reducer.position_value_lamports (last mark, else cost basis incl. deposit). It is not in closed counts, hit rate, profit factor, expectancy or breakdown.
deviations.reason: Mark enters the window through the equity curve the caller supplies.

deviations.implemented_as: Sharpe uses sample standard deviation (N-1). Sortino uses downside deviation over all N steps. Annualization factor is sqrt(365 * steps / elapsed_days), with 365 imported from backtest/metrics.py.
deviations.reason: Index specifies sample standard deviation for Sharpe; Sortino downside convention is stated in the module docstring.

deviations.implemented_as: A step whose prior equity is not positive has no return and is skipped from the return series. The step count for annualization still counts every curve point.
deviations.reason: Undefined return cannot be zero or infinite (BT-08).
